title: Enderscape: Don't Squint
description: Fixes the "Rustle" eye texture to be symmetrical.
body:
![footage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f41877a7637ed23abd9c2fe39ca54b7f3afb58f8.png)
Enderscape: Don't Squint is a small resource pack that fixes the eye texture of the Rustle. This pack updates the "in bucket" texture as well as the entity texture. Find the REQUIRED Enderscape mod [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape). 






_This is an unofficial Enderscape resource pack and was not created or uploaded by [lunarbunten](https://modrinth.com/user/lunarbunten)._
